paragraphs: Today is the day of the fishing trip. Tom and Grandpa are at the lake with Pip. Grandpa has a net and an old hat. He has a bag of sandwiches too. "What's in your bag, Tom?" asks Grandpa. "I always bring a bottle of water," says Tom. "Good!" says Grandpa. "Now we need the boat." The boat is small and blue. Grandpa puts the bag in the boat. Pip wants to come too. "You can come, Pip," says Tom, "but be quiet and careful!"

They sit in the boat on the lake. The water is green and quiet. Grandpa holds the net in the water. He says, "Fish don't like noise." Tom is quiet. Pip is quiet too, but not for long. He sees a fish in the water. "Woof!" says Pip. Splash! Pip jumps into the lake!

"Pip!" shouts Tom. Grandpa is quick. He puts the net in the water and catches Pip. Pip is wet, and he is very sad. Tom and Grandpa laugh. "My first catch today is a wet puppy!" says Grandpa. Pip is tired and hungry. Tom gives him some of his sandwich. "Is it a good trip?" asks Grandpa. "Yes, it is!" says Tom.
text.summary: Tom and Pip go on a fishing trip with Grandpa. Pip jumps into the lake, and Grandpa catches him with the net.
